prompts.text: Some students have a background, identity, interest, or talent that is so meaningful they believe their application would be incomplete without it. If this sounds like you, then please share your story.
prompts.quote: Whether applying with the Common App or Rutgers Application, Rutgers requires that first-year applicants provide a short, original essay.

prompts.text: The lessons we take from obstacles we encounter can be fundamental to later success. Recount a time when you faced a challenge, setback, or failure. How did it affect you, and what did you learn from the experience?
